## How it was checked

- [ ] `corepack pnpm check`, `typecheck` and `test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour that changed
- [ ] The document that owns the behaviour is updated (see `docs/README.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or real imported content in code, tests or fixtures

## Developer Certificate of Origin

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, or `git rebase --signoff main`), certifying the [DCO 1.1](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin)
